keyword.zh: 混凝土泵外形尺寸是米还是毫米

description.zh: 泵的外形尺寸单位为什么不一样。2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm仍在目录格子里。插图来自「卡尺」。

h1.en: Dimension Units Differ on Pump Sheets is a catalogue comparison, not a page from Calipers
h1.zh: 泵的外形尺寸单位为什么不一样是目录对照，不是「卡尺」那一页

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists outline dimensions on its Xingtai concrete pumps, but the unit is not always millimetres. Electric 20 lists 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calipers.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵上标出了外形尺寸，但单位不总是毫米。电动20为 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calipers。

body.en: Picture source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calipers. Subject: Caliper detail view. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists outline dimensions on its Xingtai concrete pumps, but the unit is not always millimetres. Reading 6.6 as millimetres would shrink the machine a thousandfold. LZ-60 and LZ-80 both list 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. The label is L×W×H, length, width and height.
body.zh: 图片来源：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calipers。画面主体：Caliper detail view。河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵上标出了外形尺寸，但单位不总是毫米。把 6.6 读成毫米，会把机器缩小一千倍。LZ-60 标出 50 m³/h 和 300 m 高度。

body.en: Electric 20 lists 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm. Read the unit shown at the end of the entry. The same dimensions do not make the pumps the same. A 915 mm length on B500S-83D is the first number, not the height.
body.zh: 电动20为 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm。拖泵和紧凑页，例如电动15（1900 × 900 × 1200 mm）、柴油120（7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm）和搅拌泵一体机（3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm），写的是 mm。LZ-80 标出两档产量上限，高度格写的是咨询工厂标准。

body.en: B500S-83D lists 915 × 550 × 550 mm. Trailer and compact pages such as Electric 15 (1900 × 900 × 1200 mm), Diesel 120 (7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm) and the integrated mixer (3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm) state mm. LZ-60 lists 50 m³/h and a 300 m height.
body.zh: B500S-83D 为 915 × 550 × 550 mm。河北品锦机械给出的是写出的外形，不是现场布置图。B500S-83D 的 915 mm 是第一个数，即长度，不是高度。

body.en: LZ-60 and LZ-80 list 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. Hebei Pinjin Machinery is stating the shown outline, not a site layout drawing. LZ-80 lists two output ceilings and a height entry that says consult factory standard.

question.en: Which pumps list dimensions in metres?

answer.en: LZ-60 and LZ-80. Both list 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calipers.
answer.zh: LZ-60 和 LZ-80。两边都是 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calipers画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Is 6.6 m the same as 6.6 mm?
question.zh: 6.6 m 和 6.6 mm 一样吗？

answer.en: No. The entry says m. Other pumps that intend millimetres list mm. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calipers.
answer.zh: 不一样。这一格写的是 m。打算用毫米的其他泵会标出 mm。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calipers画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Does the same metre outline mean the same pump?
question.zh: 相同的米制外形就是同一台泵吗？

answer.en: No. LZ-60 and LZ-80 share the dimension line and differ on output, engine and height. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calipers.
answer.zh: 不是。LZ-60 和 LZ-80 外形行相同，产量、发动机和高度不同。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calipers画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: What does L×W×H mean?

answer.en: Length, width and height, in that order, as shown by Hebei Pinjin Machinery. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calipers.
answer.zh: 按河北品锦机械写出的顺序：长、宽、高。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calipers画面里印出的数字。
